verses.text: A Psalm of David. The LORD is my shepherd, I shall not want.
verses.textZh: （大衛的詩。）耶和華是我的牧者，我必不致缺乏。

verses.text: He makes me lie down in green pastures; He leads me beside quiet waters.
verses.textZh: 他使我躺臥在青草地上，領我在可安歇的水邊。

verses.text: He restores my soul; He guides me in the paths of righteousness For His name's sake.
verses.textZh: 他使我的靈魂甦醒，為自己的名引導我走義路。

verses.text: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I fear no evil, for You are with me; Your rod and Your staff, they comfort me.
verses.textZh: 我雖然行過死蔭的幽谷，也不怕遭害，因為你與我同在；你的杖，你的竿，都安慰我。

verses.text: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies; You have anointed my head with oil; My cup overflows.
verses.textZh: 在我敵人面前，你為我擺設筵席；你用油膏了我的頭，使我的福杯滿溢。

verses.text: Surely goodness and lovingkindness will follow me all the days of my life, And I will dwell in the house of the LORD forever.
verses.textZh: 我一生一世必有恩惠慈愛隨著我；我且要住在耶和華的殿中，直到永遠。
